title: Principal Schur specialization and GL2 plethysm in logarithmic space
title_zh_cn: 主特化 Schur 系数与 GL₂ plethysm 的对数空间算法

contribution_structure.main_theorem: Principal Schur specialization coefficient functions are in FL_nonnegative, hence in #L, with unbounded partition length.
direct_corollaries: The specified two-row GL2 plethysm coefficient functions are in FL_nonnegative, hence in #L.
Hermite coefficient functions are in FL_nonnegative, hence in #L.

primary.space_measure: O(log L) work space for total input length L
primary.machine_model: read-only input, write-only output, deterministic logspace transducer

math_scope_encoding.plethysm_valid_domain: mu is a partition of w, k >= 0, and 0 <= 2r <= wk
math_scope_encoding.hermite_valid_domain: n,k >= 0 and 0 <= 2r <= nk; degenerate cases handled separately

mixed_encoding_extension.reduction: Replace k by min(k,r) for coefficients of degrees at most r.

evidence.ai_agent_reviews: internal only; not external peer review
evidence.finite_exact_checks: support arithmetic identities and implementation boundaries

project_provenance: Independent derivations within the same project were consolidated into one manuscript; overlapping conclusions are not counted as separate discoveries.

external_dependencies.used_result: Corollary 6.3; uniform integer iterated multiplication and division

external_dependencies.scope: Retracts parts 1 and 3 of Corollary 6.6, not the integer arithmetic result used here.
